_comment: Factory budgets + caps SIZED TO UNIT ECONOMICS. 1 client pays $200/mo, so paid-API spend must stay a small fraction. Real measured spend ~$1.43/mo, so these have big headroom AND force max-free-min-paid: if a nightly run approaches the cap, make it cheaper (fewer Haiku/paid calls), do NOT raise the cap. daily cap = no single NIGHT can burst (every paid call gates on budget.can_spend; at the cap paid calls are DENIED, factory keeps running on free routes). Raise proportionally as PAYING clients are added (~10-15% of each client's fee). kill_switch_paid_spend=true = emergency brake.
_disabled_note: Providers turned OFF (operator 2026-10-08): hunter=out of free credits; prospeo+apollo=deprecated endpoints (migration not worth it, free plans block people-search). Better 3 providers that work than 7 that flake. Re-enable by removing from the list once fixed/refilled. Serper is NOT disabled (operator refilling credits).
_nightly_call_caps_note: Hard per-NIGHT COUNT cap per provider (operator 2026-10-08), enforced in budget.can_spend ON TOP of the USD caps. serper=1000 searches/night: a runaway miner loop can't burn the night's search budget even though each search is ~$0.001. 0/absent = no count cap.
